title: EarlyE - Hide & Seek ft. Jadakiss
htmlContent:
I couldn't hold back the support on this one. This is classic Jadakiss on a 90s R&B Track flow. Gotta Luv it...
The evolution of R&B in 2018 is a soulful retro vibe from a time when the music changed in the early 90's from Icons like Mary J. Blige and R.Kelly. The emergence of Hip-Hop/R&B not only changed music forever but also the influences for "Early", today. A throwback soulful voice in the vain of Aaron Hall, Joe or Case.
However, in the new music game, there are no borders. EARLY can spit rhymes and plans on showcasing his versatility in much of his other music. Because of his reputation for spitting and singing EARLY connected with a fellow New Yorker and, Hip Hop maestro, JADAKISS for his inaugural single.
EARLY being an upstate NY street legend, specifically chose to work with another lyrical maven from the hood. "HIDE and SEEK" is currently playing on the terrestrial radio on the top 20 markets around the country. Check out the new High-Velocity video "HIDE and SEEK" off the "Flat Earth, Intelligent Design" album coming this year.
